prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on what you need (services, budget, audience, level of regulatory experience, and whether you want a local partner). I can help find the best fit for you, but first: a few quick questions.

Questions to narrow it down
- What kind of healthcare organization are you (hospital/health system, clinic, specialty practice, med device, pharma, biotech, payer, health tech startup)?
- Which services do you need? (branding, digital/SEO, paid media, social, content, PR, physician/patient recruitment, CRM/email, UX/web development, analytics)
- Budget range (monthly/annual)?
- Geographic focus: local St. Louis patients, regional, or national?
- Do you require HIPAA/regulated-industry experience or clinical trial/pharma-specific expertise?
- Timeline and any past agency experience or must-have capabilities?

If you want to proceed now, I can:
- Send a short, ranked shortlist of St. Louis-based healthcare marketing agencies matched to your answers (with strengths, sample results to request, and estimated pricing).
- Or give a general shortlist and what to ask each agency before hiring.

What would you like me to do next?

If you prefer to move forward yourself, here are quick criteria and questions to use when evaluating agencies
- Relevant experience: request case studies for healthcare clients (metrics: patient volume lift, lead cost, enrollment, website conversions).
- Regulatory know-how: HIPAA compliance, FDA/pharma experience if applicable.
- Team and roles: who will do the work, availability, senior involvement.
- Measurement: which KPIs they’ll track and reporting cadence.
- Tools & tech: EMR integrations, CRM, marketing automation, analytics stack.
- References: ask for 2–3 client references and contact them.
- Pricing & scope: clear statement of work, deliverables, KPIs, termination/milestone terms.

Want me to search and shortlist St. Louis agencies now? If so, answer the questions above or tell me the top priorities.
